docs:
`preset-b2b-storage` installed the stable `b2b:storage` composition: Data, Authentication, App access, Organizations, and Storage. Render `B2BStorageConsoleKit` with a secret-free tenant descriptor.

Degraded states: stock Storage can remain unavailable when no supported public bucket and file contract is routed; other proven modules continue independently.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/console-kit/
